name: Bureau Veritas
original_rationale: TIC network: regulatory/mandatory demand, diversified end markets, ~5% post-lease FCF yield; base 6.25% organic (blend of verified 10.2% FY24 and 5% H1-26). Risks: cyclic commodity/industrial segments, Wendel stake overhang.
measurable_expectations: Organic growth >=5% p.a. (LEAP|28 mid-to-high single digit)

scenarios_local.base_growth_source: GUIDANCE-ANCHORED OVERRIDE: FY2024 10.2% confirmed; FY2023 recall-sourced; H1-2026 organic 5.0% (Q2 5.5%); LEAP|28 mid-to-high single digit target. Blend pending verification.

principal_risks: High EM/China exposure and commodity/oil sensitivity in I&C.
Business Assurance (certification) growth slow and exposed to AI/digital audit.
Wendel forward-sale overhang; M&A acceleration may dilute returns.
thesis_break_conditions: Cash conversion below 90% for two years.
